flags: No trust center, security, privacy, or terms pages were found on explainpaper.com; the standard pages (/privacy, /trust, /security, /terms) all return 404, and only a fulfillment policy is accessible.

Nudge Security lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 compliance, but none of these claims are verified on the vendor's own domain; third-party aggregators may have outdated or inaccurate data for a small startup.
The product handles user-uploaded research papers and uses LLMs for explanations, but no privacy policy document was found, so GDPR Article 13/14 compliance cannot be evaluated.

There is no documentation of whether uploaded papers or queries are used for LLM training, whether a customer opt-out exists, or what the data retention timelines are; this matters most for users uploading proprietary or sensitive research.
A third-party profile (Nudge Security) claims HIPAA compliance, but no healthcare-related features or PHI handling are documented for this product, suggesting an over-claim or misclassification.

FedRAMP is a US federal government authorization, and there is no evidence Explain Paper is a federal contractor or has pursued it; the FedRAMP claim is likely an incorrect attribution in the Nudge Security profile.

Explain Paper was founded by Aman Jha and Jade Asmus and its homepage claims 400K+ registered users, but there is no disclosed funding, no publicly documented formal organizational structure, and no security team highlighted.

The product accepts credit card payments for its Pro tier ($16/month), but its PCI DSS certification status is unverified; card collection for the 7-day Pro trial suggests active payment infrastructure.
